dedupe_keys.name: tartanaviation image speech and ads b trajectory datasets for terminal airspace

description: TartanAviation is an open multi-modal dataset of terminal-area airspace operations collected with equipment installed inside airport boundaries. It concurrently records images of aircraft, air traffic control speech and ADS-B trajectories at two regional airports near Pittsburgh, the towered Allegheny County Airport (KAGC) and the non-towered Pittsburgh-Butler Regional Airport (KBTP), over several months to cover different seasons, aircraft types and weather. In total it has 3.1 million images, 3,374 hours of speech and 661 days of ADS-B data, with post-processed versions that are synchronised, filtered and interpolated, and it extends the earlier TrajAir dataset of 111 days at KBTP. It was produced at Carnegie Mellon University and described in Scientific Data in 2025. Coverage is two US regional airports. Access: the data are downloaded with scripts from the castacks/TartanAviation repository, archived on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (version 1.0, January 2025), with support for samples and partial downloads. Caveats: the airports are small general aviation fields, not large commercial hubs. It supports trajectory prediction and airspace simulation around airports, training of detect-and-avoid and air traffic control automation models, and complements the OpenSky Network and the traffic toolbox catalogued here.
